notes.title: Leaving Early Access (Update 1.00)
notes.content:
Version 1.00 brings some important bug fixes and temporarily removes Plague Survival mode to allow for future gameplay updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35106163/7dfd59259effe1c0336da618f6b1bc0c42f86fbd.png[/img]

notes.title: Online Leaderboards (Update 0.75)
notes.content:
Version 0.75 brings a brand new online leaderboard system that integrates seamlessly with Steam. Compete with your friends to achieve the highest score in Plague Survival!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35106163/b027a8a2ca1f436aedb7d42ee5101ae501e4072d.png[/img]

notes.title: Plague Survival (Update 0.74)
notes.content:
Update 0.74 brings a brand new gamemode! Deep in the heart of Edron's mountains, hold out for as long as possible against the plague ridden inhabitants. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35106163/092019c1d0d0dfe84dd2165af8c392a831c8bf20.png[/img]
In Plague Survival, the player along with AI teammates fight endless waves of infected enemies. The new mode features new enemy types as well as a brand new playable location!

notes.title: Update 0.73
notes.content:
Update 0.73 is here with some helpful additions. This version of the game introduces a new soundtrack shuffling feature that blends and varies the soundtrack seamlessly. This feature plays a large role in an upcoming series of updates that aim to increase immersion and extend player engagement. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35106163/7ab5d7e4ec10d9e76c48ae080ee7f3e38cfa348f.png[/img]
The original soundtrack for Tournament: Blood & Steel is composed by the very talented [url=https://soundcloud.com/chictapi]Adam Schmieder[/url], big thank you to him for his hard work on this update and many more new features coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.72
notes.content: Update 0.72 is now officially live! This update introduces the brand new hold of Arteria to both Tournament and Arena modes. This hold will also play a vital role in the upcoming mounted combat updates.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35106163/83ecd91fa2a902f7da4735565e1425b8b2c9f28f.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35106163/84debd65e5531cba6e206b8fb4f27dec42e13df0.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35106163/891e12d1746eb199ea8ef6568ac539d7f83d6e94.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed glitched Armor Up Achievement.
[*] The death menu in custom battles has been fixed.
[*]  The settings menu UI menu persistence bug has been resolved and shadows can be toggled once again.
[/list]

notes.title: Official release July 26th!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone for the outpouring of support for the project! It has been a massive help at this stage of development and has gotten the game on its feet. 

I am excited to announce that [i]Tournament: Blood & Steel[/i] will be launching onto Steam Early Access on [b]July 26th[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35106163/218dff6f35d35b3caee07bea3e3c62f50e363fcf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Early Access is on it's way!
notes.content:
Hello, my name is Kyle and I am currently working solo to develop the medieval action RPG [b]Tournament: Blood & Steel[/b]. The game will release during the summer of 2019 shortly after the summer sale has ended. 

Upon release the game will enter a brief early access period and eventually be released as a finished product. I have been working on the game for just over two years and I am very excited to show it to the world. Add [b]Tournament: Blood & Steel[/b] to your wishlist to stay up to date on announcements and updates!
